title: HistoryNoteRepository
responsibility: Reads and appends the Harness note of a commit.

inputs.name: HistoryNoteRepository.constructor.root
inputs.description: Root passed to GitAdapter as the working directory for every Git command. The constructor stores it without checking whether it is a repository.

inputs.name: HistoryNoteRepository.text.commit
inputs.description: Git object name passed to git notes show to select a commit note. This method does not validate the value before calling Git.

inputs.name: HistoryNoteRepository.read.commit
inputs.description: Commit identifier used to retrieve and parse a note; parsed entries are retained only when their recorded commit equals this value. The class does not validate it before calling Git.

inputs.name: HistoryNoteRepository.append.commit
inputs.description: Commit identifier whose Harness note receives the serialized entries. The class does not validate it before using Git, and each entry records the commit it belongs to.

inputs.name: HistoryNoteRepository.append.entries
inputs.description: History note objects serialized as one canonical JSON line each and merged into the target note. Existing lines are retained, and duplicate lines do not create a change.

inputs.name: HistoryNoteRepository.merge.other
inputs.description: Other Git notes ref passed to git notes merge against this repository's Harness notes ref. The class passes the ref through without validating it.

inputs.name: HistoryNoteRepository.all.at
inputs.description: Optional full lowercase 40-character commit hash of a notes commit whose tree should be read; null yields an empty Map and omission reads the current notes ref. A supplied non-null value outside that hash format throws ExpectedCliError.

outputs.name: HistoryNoteRepository.text
outputs.description: Raw text returned for the commit's note. It resolves to an empty string when git notes show exits with a non-zero status.

outputs.name: HistoryNoteRepository.read
outputs.description: Parsed note for the supplied commit, with valid matching entries in entries and malformed or foreign lines described in problems. The parser compares each entry's recorded commit with the supplied commit.

outputs.name: HistoryNoteRepository.append
outputs.description: Resolves true when the notes ref advances after adding at least one new line. It resolves false when the entries add no new line or the update produces no new notes commit.

outputs.name: HistoryNoteRepository.merge
outputs.description: Resolves true when the notes ref advances after merging the other ref's lines as a sorted union. It resolves false when the merge leaves the current notes unchanged.

outputs.name: HistoryNoteRepository.all
outputs.description: Map keyed by noted commit ID, with each value containing that commit's parsed entries and problems. Without at it reads the current notes ref; null returns an empty Map, while a hash reads the notes tree held by that commit.

outputs.name: HistoryNoteRepository.verifications
outputs.description: Verification notes from the current notes ref whose entries validate and whose source.commit matches the commit named by the note tree. Other note kinds, malformed lines, and verification entries for another commit are omitted.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when all receives a non-null revision that is not a full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal hash, or when the notes ref still changes after all 20 update attempts.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by GitAdapter.run or bytes when the invoked Git command exits with a non-zero status.

errors.name: BoundedCommandFailure
errors.description: Rejects Git command execution on process failure, timeout, or output-bound failure. The command adapter retains only bounded captured output.
